name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

overview: The world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing free health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to economically vulnerable families, and to all senior citizens aged 70 and above.
objectives: Provide financial protection against catastrophic health expenditure
Improve access to quality secondary and tertiary healthcare
Reduce out-of-pocket health expenditure for poor and vulnerable families

benefits.title: Cashless Hospitalisation
benefits.description: Free treatment up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals

benefits.title: Cover for Pre-existing Diseases
benefits.description: All pre-existing diseases covered from day one

otherCriteria: Families identified as per SECC 2011 deprivation criteria, or all citizens aged 70+ under AB PM-JAY Vay Vandana

applicationProcess.description: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or through Ayushman Mitra at hospital
Get Ayushman Card made using Aadhaar and family ID
Avail cashless treatment at empanelled hospital

faqs.question: What is the coverage amount?
faqs.answer: Rs. 5 lakh per family per year.

faqs.question: Are pre-existing diseases covered?
faqs.answer: Yes, from the very first day of enrolment.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

overview: A safe motherhood intervention promoting institutional delivery among pregnant women, especially those from below poverty line families, to reduce maternal and neo-natal mortality.
objectives: Promote institutional delivery among poor pregnant women
Provide cash assistance for delivery and post-delivery care

benefits.title: Cash Assistance
benefits.description: Financial assistance to pregnant women for institutional delivery, varying by rural/urban status

otherCriteria: Pregnant women, especially BPL and SC/ST women opting for institutional delivery

applicationProcess.description: Opt for institutional delivery at government or accredited private facility
Receive cash assistance through ASHA worker or directly

faqs.question: Who is eligible for JSY?
faqs.answer: Pregnant women, with focus on those from low-income and SC/ST households.

faqs.question: How is the cash disbursed?
faqs.answer: Directly to the beneficiary or through ASHA facilitation.

name: Mission Indradhanush

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

overview: An immunization scheme aimed at ensuring full vaccination coverage for all children and pregnant women against vaccine-preventable diseases.
objectives: Achieve full immunisation coverage for children and pregnant women

benefits.title: Free Vaccination
benefits.description: Immunisation against diseases such as diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus, polio, measles and more, at no cost

otherCriteria: Children up to 2 years and pregnant women

applicationProcess.description: Visit nearest Anganwadi centre or health facility during immunisation drives
Get child/pregnant woman vaccinated as per schedule
Vaccination recorded on Mother and Child Protection Card

faqs.question: Who conducts Mission Indradhanush?
faqs.answer: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare through state health departments.

faqs.question: Is vaccination free?
faqs.answer: Yes, all vaccines under the mission are provided free of cost.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
overview: A scheme to provide quality generic medicines at affordable prices to the masses through dedicated Janaushadhi Kendras across the country.
objectives: Ensure access to quality medicines at affordable prices

benefits.title: Affordable Medicines
benefits.description: Generic medicines priced 50-90% lower than branded equivalents, sold through Janaushadhi Kendras

otherCriteria: Available to all citizens; anyone can purchase from Janaushadhi Kendras

requiredDocuments.name: Not applicable for purchase; documents required only for opening a Kendra

applicationProcess.description: Locate the nearest Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendra
Purchase prescribed generic medicines at the outlet

faqs.question: Are these medicines as effective as branded ones?
faqs.answer: Yes, generic medicines meet the same quality standards as branded drugs.

faqs.question: How much cheaper are Janaushadhi medicines?
faqs.answer: Generally 50% to 90% cheaper than branded alternatives.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

overview: A mission to create a seamless digital health ecosystem by providing every citizen a unique digital health ID and enabling interoperable health records across healthcare providers.
objectives: Create a unified digital health ecosystem
Provide citizens control over their digital health records

benefits.title: ABHA Health ID
benefits.description: A unique digital health identity to link and access health records

benefits.title: Digital Health Records
benefits.description: Secure, consent-based access to personal health records

applicationProcess.description: Create an Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) via app or portal
Link health records with ABHA ID
Share records with consent at healthcare facilities

faqs.question: Is ABHA mandatory?
faqs.answer: No, it is voluntary but recommended for easier access to digital health records.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, ABDM uses a consent-based framework to protect personal health data.
